function.name: search_invoices
function.description: Search invoices by exact number, client name, date interval or unpaid balance. Dates ISO. No guessed year.

function.name: search_quotes
function.description: Find devis/quotes by client name AND product name/reference, date range or quote number. Return authorized choices, never require an internal ID.

function.name: search_documents
function.description: Search pro forma invoices (proforma), credit notes/factures avoir (credit_note), or delivery notes/bons de livraison (delivery_note). Combine client AND product filters; never require remembered IDs.

function.name: search_articles
function.description: Find articles/products/services by reference or designation. Archived is optional. Prices follow the existing member access.

function.name: search_payments
function.description: Find règlements/payments by invoice number, client name, product, status or dates. Valide means collected; Annulé is not collected.

function.name: search_operations
function.description: Find stock balances, movements, receipts, inventories, or permitted logistics orders by product/reference/location/client/supplier. Use only filters supported for that resource. Stock status is État; logistics status is Phase du dossier. Read only.

function.name: get_record
function.description: Retrieve a previously identified proforma, credit note, delivery note, article, payment, user, stock record or logistics order. IDs must come from authorized results, never guesses.

function.name: get_invoice
function.description: Get a specific authorized invoice. Omit invoice_id only when current page is an invoice.

function.name: search_clients
function.description: Search client name or exact client ID; use related_invoice for the current invoice client.

function.name: financial_summary
function.description: Existing dashboard metric: invoiced_net_ttc = invoices TTC minus active credits, collected = valid payments, outstanding = invoice balance, invoice_count = issued records. Not profit. Currency required.

function.name: list_payments
function.description: Latest valid payments in the current company; optional date range.

function.name: navigate
function.description: Explicit request to open an authorized page or a specific invoice/client. Supply ID or invoice_number. Never a URL.

function.name: previous_results
function.description: Show or open previous authorized results by 1-based index. Unpaid filtering applies only to invoices.

function.name: invoice_pdf
function.description: Offer a PDF of an invoice only with existing print rights; requires invoice_id.

function.name: knowledge
function.description: Retrieve approved instructions, invoice creation workflow, payment/status meanings or financial definitions.

function.name: prepare_change
function.description: Prepare an edit or deletion of ONE authorized invoice, quote, proforma, credit note, delivery note or client for human confirmation. Never executes it. Changes: invoice remarque/termes_paiement/date_echeance; client raison_sociale/nom/prenom/adresse. Quotes allow remarque/date_echeance only. Credit notes allow remarque only and must be Brouillon; delivery notes allow remarque/date_echeance; proformas use invoice fields. Other edits use the existing form.
